purpose: Continue closure sweep using direct current Omgevingsplan and official-policy sources.

verified: Omgevingsplan gemeente Epe CVDR696234 is current from 15-01-2026.
The current plan has a dedicated woonruimte structure: article 4.12 applicability, 4.13 good residential/living climate objective and 4.14 linkage to section 5.2.40 woonruimte gebruiken.
Chapter 8 contains general application-requirement architecture for omgevingsvergunning applications and explicitly covers permits arising from the temporary part/current municipal rules.
Current woningsplitsing policy CVDR736220 explicitly separates woningsplitsing from kamerverhuur and confirms kamerverhuur has its own Omgevingsplan regulation.
Current kavelsplitsing policy CVDR755800 is separately identified so parcel splitting is not confused with dwelling splitting.
records.importantInterpretation: The current plan is being built in layers and legally includes related/integrated regulations and the still-operative temporary part. Therefore a generic search that does not expose the complete room-rental rule in one visible article is not evidence that no rule exists. Concrete applicability must follow the current plan and its integrated components.
remainingAllowedOnly: extract exact room-rental rule from the relevant integrated/current-plan component if publicly exposed in a stable source
dynamic activity-specific documents and exact fee generated by the current application route

verified: Afwijkingenbeleid Eemsdelta 2025 CVDR734964 is a current BOPA policy under the Omgevingswet.
It explicitly exists to assess concrete requests for omgevingsvergunning for a buitenplanse omgevingsplanactiviteit.
The policy records the regular eight-week decision framework for these requests.
The policy contains substantive rules for splitting and kamergewijze verhuur, so the earlier generic substantive-law gap is closed.
records.feeQualityFinding: A search result for 'Legesverordening Eemsdelta 2026' shows that the initially published 2026 instrument ceased on 23-01-2026. Therefore no fee from that superseded version is copied into the product without locating the successor/current tariff table. This is an intentional anti-staleness safeguard.
remainingAllowedOnly: locate current successor 2026 leges/tariff table before encoding a fee
current municipal application/concept-request page and stable generic document package
concrete-address Omgevingsplan/BOPA applicability and any dynamically requested studies
